item.title: Upcoming Events
item.description:
SKEGNESS COACH TRIP

Sunday 7th June 2026

Our bi-annual and ever popular Skegness day trip for our members, friends and families.

Tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis and are very reasonably priced at just £15. Renal patients will get refunded on the day.

Departs Leicester General Hospital @8AM Return Leaves Skegness @5PM

Sun Screen is always essential as Claire always books the weather for these events, amazing!
